scripts.dev: npm run build -w @mandate/doc -w @mandate/shared && concurrently -k -n doc,shared,server,web -c gray,gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @mandate/doc" "npm run dev -w @mandate/shared" "npm run dev -w @mandate/server" "npm run dev -w @mandate/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mandate/doc -w @mandate/shared && npm run build -w @mandate/server && npm run build -w @mandate/web && npm run build -w getmandate
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @mandate/doc -w @mandate/shared && npm run typecheck -w @mandate/doc -w @mandate/shared -w @mandate/server -w @mandate/web -w getmandate
scripts.test: npm run build -w @mandate/doc -w @mandate/shared && npm run test -w @mandate/doc -w @mandate/shared -w @mandate/server -w @mandate/web -w getmandate
scripts.seed: npm run build -w @mandate/doc -w @mandate/shared && npm run seed -w @mandate/server --
scripts.pack:cli: npm run build && npm pack -w getmandate
